summary: Edinburgh, Scotland, Computer Science degree holder, software developer, interested in programming languages (especially Lisp and JavaScript), enjoys reading (notable authors include Robert Fisk, Neal Stephenson, and Orwell), has a strong interest in history and geopolitics, advocates for socialized healthcare (supportive of the NHS), has a family structure including a wife and children, enjoys cycling and outdoor activities, has experience in startup environments and venture capital, critical of bureaucracy and management practices, engaged in discussions about technology and its societal impacts, has a background in AI research, and has a preference for practical applications over theoretical discussions.
